column1: # Why measures: a charge-pump PLL locking a 400 MHz d_osc VCO, divided by 40,
# to a 10 MHz reference over 25 us. Its plotted outputs s1, s2, u1n and d1
# are dac_bridge copies of digital nets with 0.1 ns ramps, and ngspice-46
# moves those edges by up to 153 ps under its own 10x timestep refinement
# (.tran 0.1n against 0.01n), more than a whole ramp. A pointwise sample
# taken on a ramp therefore compares where two runs happened to step, not
# the loop: the stored reference differs from ngspice's own 10x run by more
# than the pointwise tolerance at 28 u1n and 22 d1 of its 1,001 rows.
# Against ngspice at the deck step, RSpice places all 245 divider edges, 250
# reference edges and 245 pump pulses in the same order, with the same count,
# closer than ngspice's own refinement scatter, and tracks the control
# voltage cont to 1.4e-4 V where ngspice's refinement moves it 1.8e-4 V.
# The gates measure what the deck is for: cont settling to lock, the divided
# VCO's period converging on the 100 ns reference, and the phase detector's
# edges. The stored table keeps 1,001 rows, one per 25 ns, too sparse to
# resolve a 0.1 ns edge, so every gate carries ref=: the value measured from
# ngspice-46 at the deck step at full resolution (.tran 0.1n 25u uic,
# trapezoidal, every accepted point). Each tolerance is twice the larger of
# ngspice's own movement under 10x refinement and RSpice's deviation from
# ref=, taken over every crossing or window of the family (in a
# full-resolution RSpice run, and the gate run itself):
#   family                               ngspice 10x moves   RSpice deviates   tolerance
#   cont means, ten windows                   7.4e-5 V           3.2e-5 V        1.5e-4 V
#   s1 rises at 0.5 (divider)                 153 ps              64 ps          310 ps
#   s2 rises at 0.5 (reference)                95 ps              95 ps          200 ps
#   u1n falls at 0.25 (pump up)               153 ps              64 ps          310 ps
#   d1 rises at 0.75 (pump down)               95 ps              95 ps          200 ps
#   s1 period, 5-10 us                        0.60 ps            0.39 ps         1.2 ps
#   s1 period, 10-25 us                       0.29 ps            0.24 ps         0.57 ps
# u1n and d1 start at out_undef = 0.5 until the phase detector's flip-flops
# are first clocked, so their gates read 0.25 and 0.75, never the 0.5 level
